title: Mashed Sweet Potatoes
description: Sweet potatoes mashed with butter, milk, and maple syrup.
instructions:
Place the sweet potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Stir 1 tablespoon salt into the water.

Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to maintain a gentle boil. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the potatoes are easily pierced with a fork.

Drain the potatoes and return to the pot. Add the butter, milk, maple syrup, salt, and several grinds of pepper. Use a potato masher to mash until smooth and well combined.

Season to taste and serve topped with more butter and fresh thyme leaves, if desired.

ingredients.note: about 5 large or 6 medium, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.raw: 3 pounds sweet potatoes (about 5 large or 6 medium, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes)

ingredients.note: cut into pats, plus more for serving
ingredients.raw: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter (cut into pats, plus more for serving)

ingredients.note: plus more for cooking the potatoes
ingredients.raw: 1 teaspoon sea salt (plus more for cooking the potatoes)
